Measure actual DEF-hoof positions and compare the last descending frames. Poll lowers during load, lifts with rise/crest and dips during grounded absorption. Existing fixed landing dust/clod groups reanchor on measured contact and retain settled solids.

brief.strategy: Whole support representation over reference phases, followed by contact reconstruction and phase review. Flight wrist paths are projected inside the flexed reach sphere only while airborne; grounded reach remains strict. Small supported placement steps precede lift; forelegs have one-frame release/contact separation. Separate finite-velocity flight arrival from grounded contact; body absorption follows impact. Reference-driven head load/lift/recovery and existing landing debris retimed to independent hoof contacts; never generic periodic neck noise.

method_choice.alternatives: Do not retime root-rotation curves again, restore unknown drivers, recapture modified baseline or use independent easing phases stopping at impact.
